title: Figs. 6-7: Gemini D-9 hand held space sextant and M-3 In-Flight Exerciser
description: Two photographs from NASA document M-913-65-04. Fig. 6, titled "D-9 SIMPLE NAVIGATION," shows a compact optical instrument labeled "HAND HELD SPACE SEXTANT"; Fig. 7, titled "M-3 IN-FLIGHT EXERCISER," shows an astronaut in a Gemini cockpit using a bungee-cord exerciser, with the handle-and-cord device shown separately at right. Text explains navigation sightings using horizon and stars and isotonic exercise tests to assess work capacity in spaceflight.
